subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic read-only `routing.list` Gateway RPC and Agents > Channels binding card for per-agent Discord channel bindings, or keep binding visibility in config/CLI/docs surfaces?
rationale: The request improves visibility for existing stable Discord binding behavior, but it adds new core Gateway protocol and Control UI surface rather than repairing a documented broken behavior.

options.title: Accept generic routing visibility
options.body: Review and refresh the linked implementation or a replacement so current main exposes a read-only routing summary and renders selected-agent bindings with focused tests and real UI proof.

options.title: Keep existing visibility surfaces
options.body: Decide that config docs, current config inspection, and future CLI ergonomics remain the supported way to inspect these bindings, then close this direction.

options.title: Defer the API shape
options.body: Keep the issue open as a design item until maintainers settle whether the summary contract should be generic routing, Discord-specific UI, or another diagnostics surface.

recommendation.title: Accept generic routing visibility
recommendation.body: Review and refresh the linked implementation or a replacement so current main exposes a read-only routing summary and renders selected-agent bindings with focused tests and real UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects the Agents Control UI shape and Gateway product/API boundary, and steipete has the clearest related triage/UI history in the inspected evidence.
